page.layout: One page of text (left printed page, main column); a narrow strip of the facing page at the right edge, partly visible, with fragmentary text in the margin; a signature mark at the foot left. The facing page's fragments are not transcribed as main text.

main_text.p: gantiarum jactare soli- tus apud stolidos adole- scentes, modò apud illos consequatur famam vir- tutis. Hæc sententia adhuc animo fixa sederet, nisi invidia & malevo- lentia, quæ ubique ter- rarum me persequutæ fuerunt, in hanc Mar- chiam usque penetras- sent, & male quidam fe- riatus, meam ignoranti- am

page.notes: The facing page at the right edge is cut off and shows only fragments (am, duc, trac, filiu, do, ope, tor, lefa, mor, & ar, lib, gros, re,ut), which are not transcribed. Long s rendered as s; s-ligature and the printed ligature forms normalised. Some letters of the print (e.g. "qvidam", "s") are read with reasonable confidence; the signature "A 3" is partly obscured. Line "fuerunt" and "gantiarum" appear as printed.
